 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Umesh Chandra Verma, Adv.
For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Veena Kumari Jaiswal, App

For the informant : Mr.Dhananjay Kumar No.2, Adv.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 18-01-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner,State and the informant.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. C-113 of 2021 instituted under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
At the outset, Umesh Chandra Verma submits that the petitioner wants to give another chance to the marriage and as such, he is ready to keep her with full dignity and owner.
Learned counsel for the informant submits that the lady is also want to continue with her conjugal life and as such is ready to join him.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.54317 of 2022(2) dt.18-01-2023
In view of the fair submissions put forward by both the parties, this Court direct the petitioner to visit his in-laws' house and take his wife home.
Further, they will be appearing together before this Court on 15.2.2023.
